title: What's New: Server and Database - More Stable Web Services (2023 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Editable Property in OData and Edit in Excel
Server Return Codes and Retry Headers
Troubleshooting Guides and Power BI Telemetry
Web Service Queuing and Telemetry Visibility
HTTP Client Error Handling Best Practices
Upcoming Changes and Delta Link Deprecation

features.name: Editable Property Support in OData for Edit in Excel
features.description: OData V4 now evaluates the editable property just like the UI does, supporting not just Boolean variables but also calculated properties. This allows pages previously unusable for Edit in Excel due to calculated editable properties to now work correctly.
caveats: Mainly relevant for Edit in Excel functionality which uses OData on top of UI pages
API pages should generally be used instead of normal pages exposed to OData

features.name: HTTP 503 Return Code for Request Queue Timeout
features.description: When a web service request waits in the request queue and times out, the server now returns HTTP 503 with a retry-after header, allowing clients to decide when to retry the call later.
caveats: Requires clients to implement retry logic based on the retry-after header

features.name: Invalid Metadata Handling with Telemetry Emissions
features.description: When invalid metadata is detected such as duplicate page names, the problematic endpoint is now ignored rather than causing all web services to fail. Partner telemetry is emitted to alert developers without requiring customer escalation.
caveats: Developers should monitor telemetry rather than waiting for customer reports
Multiple extensions installed can cause duplicate metadata issues

features.name: Web Service Endpoints Failure Telemetry Page
features.description: A new telemetry page shows which web service endpoints fail at runtime and provides hints on how to fix them. Enables proactive monitoring via Power BI alerts before customer discovery.
caveats: Requires active monitoring of telemetry app

features.name: Troubleshooting Guides for HTTP Status Codes
features.description: New troubleshooting guide documents added to help developers understand HTTP status codes and how to fix issues. Specific guides address incoming and outgoing web service status codes.

features.name: User Agent Tracking in Power BI Telemetry
features.description: User agent information in web service calls now persists through telemetry, allowing developers to identify which specific web service clients are experiencing problems in Power BI reports.

features.name: HTTP Status Code and Exception Telemetry in Power BI
features.description: Power BI telemetry apps for both incoming and outgoing web service calls now display HTTP status codes, exceptions, and AL call stacks with improved filtering capabilities.

features.name: Web Service Request Queuing Time Telemetry
features.description: Queue time for incoming web service calls is now visible in telemetry and Power BI reports, providing statistics on server queuing delays when the system is under load.

features.name: HTTP Client Error Handling Documentation
features.description: Extensive documentation and code examples added for HTTP client usage including setup, failure modes, error handling, retry strategies, and common HTTP error codes with suggested solutions.
caveats: Documentation covers both inbound and outbound calls

features.name: HTTP Client Last Error Text for Troubleshooting
features.description: Get-last-error-text function now provides detailed error information for HTTP client failures before status codes are returned, such as URL errors, network errors, and certificate errors.

features.name: Improved SSL and Certificate Error Messages
features.description: SSL certificate error messages now provide specific details such as 'remote certificate is invalid' and 'padding is invalid and cannot be removed' instead of just generic inner exception references.

features.name: Socket Reuse Optimization for HTTP Client
features.description: HTTP client now optimizes socket usage to prevent VM port starvation when making large numbers of outgoing calls. Backported to version 2.x and requires no code changes.
caveats: Transparent optimization requiring no code changes

features.name: Custom API Schema Version Default Change
features.description: The default schema version for custom APIs will be changed.
caveats: Customers should check custom API implementations

features.name: Delta Links Support Removal
features.description: Delta link support is being removed from web services. Very few users currently rely on this functionality. Developers should stop using delta links and migrate to alternative approaches.
caveats: Six months notice given from the time of this video
